# AZ Elevated Builders

> Family-run, licensed and insured general contractor based in Brentwood, California, serving a 60-mile radius across the East Bay, Tri-Valley, Delta, Solano and Napa counties. Founded and run by Alfonso Zavala.

## Key facts
- **Business name:** AZ Elevated Builders
- **Owner:** Alfonso Zavala
- **Based in:** Brentwood, California, USA
- **Phone:** (925) 812-3150
- **Email:** Azbuild3rs@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://azelevatedbuilders.com
- **Service radius:** 60 miles from Brentwood, CA (40 cities across 5 counties)
- **Licensed:** California general contractor, licensed, bonded and insured
- **Estimates:** Free, on-site, with a written scope
- **Warranty:** Written warranty of up to 5 years on all work
- **Financing:** Available
- **Languages:** English and Spanish (hablamos español)
- **Positioning:** Quality-first, high-end residential work. Every trade on the crew has 15+ years of experience in that specific trade.

## Services
- **Kitchen Remodeling** — Layout, cabinetry, stone, lighting and fixtures — kitchens rebuilt to be the best room in the house. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/kitchen-remodeling/)
- **Bathroom Remodeling** — Spa-level baths — tile, stone, steam showers, heated floors — waterproofed right from the rough-in. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/bathroom-remodeling/)
- **Whole-Home Remodeling** — Interior and exterior remodeled as one project — layout, systems, finishes and paint under one crew. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/whole-home-remodeling/)
- **Home Additions & ADUs** — New square footage that looks original — plus ADUs that earn rent or house family. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/additions-adus/)
- **Concrete & Driveways** — Driveways, patios, walkways and retaining walls — formed, poured and finished by our own crew. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/concrete-driveways/)
- **Interior & Exterior Painting** — Full-prep painting inside and out — 22 years on the brush, straight lines, quality coatings. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/painting/)
- **Flooring Installation** — Hardwood, engineered, tile and laminate — plus radiant heat — installed flat, tight and clean. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/flooring/)
- **Drywall Installation & Repair** — Hung, taped, textured and finished by a 20-year specialist — walls you'll never think about again. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/drywall/)
- **Cabinetry & Countertops** — Custom and semi-custom cabinets with stone and quartz counters — one scope, lines that line up. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/cabinetry-countertops/)
- **Finish Carpentry & Trim** — Baseboards, casing, wainscot, built-ins and stairs — the details that separate remodels from renovations. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/finish-carpentry-trim/)
- **Steam Showers, Saunas & Heated Floors** — Spa features built from the rough-in — steam, sauna and radiant heat that work for decades. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/steam-showers-saunas/)
- **Pergolas & Outdoor Living** — Pergolas, patios, landscaping and outdoor rooms — planned as part of the house, not an afterthought. (https://azelevatedbuilders.com/services/pergolas-outdoor-living/)

## Common questions
- **Does AZ Elevated Builders offer free estimates?** Yes — every project starts with a free on-site estimate including a written scope and schedule.
- **What areas does AZ Elevated Builders serve?** A 60-mile radius from Brentwood, CA, including Antioch, Oakley, Discovery Bay, Concord, Walnut Creek, Danville, San Ramon, Livermore, Tracy, Oakland, Berkeley and Napa.
- **Is AZ Elevated Builders licensed?** Yes — a licensed, bonded and insured California general contractor.
- **What warranty is offered?** A written warranty of up to five years on all work.
- **Does the team speak Spanish?** Yes — English and Spanish.
